conclusion: Clean, well-controlled null result: same 12 items, same gold, same primary (reused), only variable changed was gemini_thinking_budget (0 -> 2048), and 9290 thinking tokens were genuinely spent. recommendation: Swap the challenger to a genuinely different model family (e.g. Claude Haiku 4.5) rather than further Gemini config tuning.
